CustomField.description: Tracks the lifecycle of a corporate matching-gift request against this transaction. Values sourced from the FQS_Match_Status GlobalValueSet so the staging GiftEntry mirror and canonical GiftTransaction copy stay in lockstep. Distinct from FQS_Matched__c (boolean, flips true when MatchingEmployerTransactionId is linked): Match Status covers the whole workflow — Eligible (identified as match-eligible), Request Confirmed (submitted to employer), Received (match arrived), Declined (employer refused), N/A (no match expected).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Where this gift stands in the corporate matching lifecycle. Leave blank or N/A if no match is expected. Complements the boolean Matched field, which only flips true once the matching transaction is linked.
CustomField.label: Match Status
